name: agent-ready
description: AI agent readability scanner. Scan any site and get scores + per-check remediation via MCP tools.
instructions: Agent Ready scans any public website for AI agent readability and returns scores plus per-check remediation. Tools: scan_site (run a scan on a URL; long scans return an id to poll), get_scan (fetch a scan by id), ask (natural-language search over Agent Ready's methodology, check registry, and validated specs). The no-auth MCP Apps endpoint additionally renders an interactive score-card widget. Read-only; only public URLs are scanned (private/internal addresses are refused).

tools.name: scan_site
tools.description: Scan a public website for AI agent readability and render the interactive score card. Returns the Vercel score, llmstxt.org score, and per-check remediation. Long scans return a scan id to poll with get_scan.

tools.name: get_scan
tools.description: Fetch a previously started scan by id and re-render the interactive score card.

tools.name: ask
tools.description: Natural-language search over Agent Ready's own content — scoring methodology, the check registry, and the validated specs. Returns Schema.org-typed results. No API key required.

resources.name: Agent Ready score
resources.title: Agent Ready score
resources.description: Interactive AI agent-readability score card and per-check breakdown for a scanned site.

servers.name: agent-ready-apps
servers.description: No-auth MCP Apps endpoint: 3 read-only tools rendering an interactive ui:// agent-readability score-card widget.

app_handshake.initialize: POST initialize with Accept: application/json, text/event-stream and Content-Type: application/json.
app_handshake.session: Stateless: no mcp-session-id header is issued or expected. Each JSON-RPC POST is self-contained.
app_handshake.after_initialize: Call notifications/initialized. Public discovery (no auth): tools/list returns app-opening tools (scan_site, get_scan) carrying _meta.ui.resourceUri; resources/list lists the ui:// resource ui://widget/agent-ready-score.html; resources/read returns text/html;profile=mcp-app app HTML.
app_handshake.tool_calls: tools/call for scan_site/get_scan is public (no auth) on the Apps endpoint; on the bearer /api/v1/mcp it requires Authorization: Bearer <API key>.
